source.retrieved_via: huggingface datasets-server /filter, server-side WHERE per benchmark

construction.seed_rule: per benchmark, the record holder on the declared metric as of the seed window end. The window is closed above and open below: what has to be closed for 'afterwards' to mean anything is the cut date, not the seed's own age. A benchmark whose record holder predates the cut by years is kept and its date recorded, because excluding it would drop exactly the benchmarks where progress had stalled
construction.followup_rule: the record-holder chain in the evaluation window: each paper that set a new best after the seed, in date order, deduplicated by arXiv id
construction.relation_basis: published number on the same benchmark, not text adjudication
construction.date_basis: arXiv identifier month unless a publication date was supplied

followups.title: Cross-sentence context (First)
followups.problem_delta: same task and benchmark as the seed (Named Entity Recognition on CoNLL 2003 (English)); the delta is in how the F1 is reached, not in what is being measured
followups.method_delta: Cross-sentence context (First) replaces CNN Large + fine-tune
followups.mechanism: extend the BERT input with neighbouring sentences and combine the several predictions each token then receives by contextual majority voting
followups.demonstrating_experiment: CoNLL 2003 (English) / F1: 93.5 -> 93.74 (previous record -> this paper), as recorded in the Papers With Code evaluation table

followups.title: LUKE: Deep Contextualized Entity Representations with Entity-aware Self-attention
followups.problem_delta: same task and benchmark as the seed (Named Entity Recognition on CoNLL 2003 (English)); the delta is in how the F1 is reached, not in what is being measured
followups.mechanism: treat entities as first-class tokens alongside words, pretrain by masking both, and extend self-attention with an entity-aware term that conditions on whether each token is a word or an entity
followups.demonstrating_experiment: CoNLL 2003 (English) / F1: 93.74 -> 94.3 (previous record -> this paper), as recorded in the Papers With Code evaluation table

followups.title: Automated Concatenation of Embeddings for Structured Prediction
followups.problem_delta: same task and benchmark as the seed (Named Entity Recognition on CoNLL 2003 (English)); the delta is in how the F1 is reached, not in what is being measured
followups.method_delta: ACE + document-context replaces CNN Large + fine-tune
followups.mechanism: search automatically over which pretrained embeddings to concatenate for a given task, instead of fixing the concatenation by hand
followups.demonstrating_experiment: CoNLL 2003 (English) / F1: 94.3 -> 94.6 (previous record -> this paper), as recorded in the Papers With Code evaluation table

pairs.seed_title: Self-training with Noisy Student improves ImageNet classification

followups.title: Fixing the train-test resolution discrepancy: FixEfficientNet
followups.problem_delta: same task and benchmark as the seed (Image Classification on ImageNet); the delta is in how the Top 1 Accuracy is reached, not in what is being measured
followups.mechanism: correct the mismatch between the image resolution seen in training and the one seen at test time, rather than changing the architecture or the training data
followups.demonstrating_experiment: ImageNet / Top 1 Accuracy: 88.4 -> 88.5 (previous record -> this paper), as recorded in the Papers With Code evaluation table

followups.title: Meta Pseudo Labels
followups.problem_delta: same task and benchmark as the seed (Image Classification on ImageNet); the delta is in how the Top 1 Accuracy is reached, not in what is being measured
followups.mechanism: the teacher is no longer fixed: it is adapted by feedback from the student's performance on the labelled set, so pseudo-label generation is itself learned rather than frozen
followups.demonstrating_experiment: ImageNet / Top 1 Accuracy: 88.5 -> 90.0 (previous record -> this paper), as recorded in the Papers With Code evaluation table

followups.title: Model soups: averaging weights of multiple fine-tuned models improves accuracy without increasing inference time
followups.problem_delta: same task and benchmark as the seed (Image Classification on ImageNet); the delta is in how the Top 1 Accuracy is reached, not in what is being measured
followups.mechanism: average the weights of models fine-tuned under different hyperparameter configurations, which lie in a single low-error basin, instead of selecting the single best and discarding the rest
followups.demonstrating_experiment: ImageNet / Top 1 Accuracy: 90.0 -> 90.94 (previous record -> this paper), as recorded in the Papers With Code evaluation table

followups.title: CoCa: Contrastive Captioners are Image-Text Foundation Models
followups.problem_delta: same task and benchmark as the seed (Image Classification on ImageNet); the delta is in how the Top 1 Accuracy is reached, not in what is being measured
followups.mechanism: one image-text encoder-decoder pretrained jointly with a contrastive loss and a captioning loss, with cross-attention omitted in the first half of the decoder so those layers encode unimodal text
followups.demonstrating_experiment: ImageNet / Top 1 Accuracy: 90.94 -> 91.0 (previous record -> this paper), as recorded in the Papers With Code evaluation table
